subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept this custom yielding bootstrap glob walker and bootstrap-hook scheduling as the narrow fix for the linked event-loop stall, or require connected embedded_run/channel proof before merge?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness finding, but it changes core bootstrap context loading and hook interleaving on a user-visible agent/message-delivery path where focused tests and direct code-path proof do not fully settle upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept narrow fix after checks
options.body: Proceed once exact-head required checks are green, treating the remaining compatibility, session-state, and availability risk as an intentional maintainer-owned tradeoff.

options.title: Require connected-channel proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run/channel keepalive or message-delivery log if direct loadExtraBootstrapFiles proof is not enough for this hot path.

options.title: Pause for scheduler architecture
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want worker isolation or request-priority scheduling instead of a targeted bootstrap-context mitigation.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow fix after checks
recommendation.body: Proceed once exact-head required checks are green, treating the remaining compatibility, session-state, and availability risk as an intentional maintainer-owned tradeoff.
